title: security: enforce rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging for private deployments
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Private deployments must guarantee that customer-managed KMS keys are used only within the specified geographic region (data residency policy). Previous RBAC v2 allowed KMS key selection but did not enforce region residency in all code paths; this created an audit gap and a potential policy violation for regulated customers.

This PR enforces KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 policy enforcer boundary and plumbs audit logging for key operations (key selection, encryption, and decryption) so that security teams can produce deterministic reports. The enforcement is gated behind a config flag for Private installer upgrades and defaults to 'audit' mode in Hosted and Dedicated to avoid unexpected failures.

What changed (high level):
- Enforce: RBAC v2 policy enforcer now validates key.region against role.allowed_regions and rejects requests that would use keys outside the allowed regions.
- Audit logging: Added structured audit events for kms.select_key, kms.encrypt, kms.decrypt with tenant_id, key_id, key_region, request_id. Events are emitted to the existing audit-log pipeline.
- Config: New private deployment flag private.kms.enforce_region_pinning (installer/helm values) and migration helper that toggles enforcement after audit window.
- Migration: Migration script to detect tenants using keys outside their allowed regions and emit remediation suggestions.
- Tests: Integration tests cover enforcement + audit emission, and unit tests for policy matcher.
- Docs: Added docs and operator runbook for enabling enforcement and rolling back.

Checklist:
- [x] Update policy enforcer logic
- [x] Add audit events and wire to audit pipeline
- [x] Installer/helm config changes + migration helper
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Docs & runbook

Notes: This PR intentionally separates the enforcement decision from the installer rollout. Default behaviour for existing Private installs remains 'audit-only' until operators run the provided migration and set private.kms.enforce_region_pinning=true. Hosted and Dedicated default to audit-only to avoid customer impact while we complete cross-region KMS key compatibility work.

Linear: ENG-4521. Support ticket SUP-1023 includes sample tenant manifests observed in the wild.

review_comments: Ethan Li: Can we avoid making the enforcer fail closed for private installs by default? Recommend audit-only until migration completes.
Aisha Kapoor: Agreed; default is audit-only for existing installs. Added installer flag and migration helper. See installer/templates/kms_config.yaml.
Marissa Gomez: Audit event schema looks good but add tenant_id and request_id fields and ensure logs are idempotent. Also add unit tests for schema validation.
Aisha Kapoor: Added tenant_id/request_id and schema unit tests (pkg/kms/audit_schema_test.go).
Samir Rao: Integration test failed in CI on first run due to race on audit pipeline; please add retry/backoff in test.
Aisha Kapoor: Fixed test to wait for audit event and added exponential backoff. Reran CI.
Ethan Li: Approved after CI green and docs added.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and add audit logging for KMS operations. Private deployments must run the migration script before enabling enforcement; default behaviour remains audit-only until operators opt in.
testing_summary: Unit tests: policy matcher edge cases + schema validation. Integration: end-to-end scenario with private installer, sample tenant using out-of-region key -> request rejected when enforcement enabled; audit events observed in audit pipeline. CI flake fixed by adding backoff in test. Manual verification performed in a staging private cluster.
migration_steps: 1) Run migrations: ./installer migrate --migration 202601_kms_region_pinning; 2) Review migration report in /var/log/redwood/migrations/202601_kms_region_pinning_report.json; 3) Remediate tenants flagged as using out-of-region keys; 4) Set private.kms.enforce_region_pinning=true in installer values and redeploy; 5) Monitor audit events and RC metrics for 24-72 hours.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Roll out to internal staging private cluster (audit-only enabled) and run migration reports. Stage 2: Notify operators and run remediation for flagged tenants. Stage 3: Flip enforcement flag per-tenant with monitored canaries. Stage 4: Full rollout with automated alerts on policy rejects. Rollback: unset private.kms.enforce_region_pinning and revert installer change; migration is non-destructive.
notes: This change intentionally emits audit events for Hosted/Dedicated but does not reject requests there by default. If compliance teams request stricter posture, we will coordinate a dedicated rollout and advance notice. The migration report intentionally includes remediation commands to make customer operator work straightforward.
